description: Southern Province Provincial Council - Notify the conferment of powers to Mrs. S. J. Wedaarachchi who appointed to assist the commissioner of Co-operative Development of the Southern Province, w.e.f. 14.12.2017
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Udalamaththaa Gamage Dayawansha Ariyathilaka) with their ministerial title and outlines detailed responsibilities (Agriculture, Agrarian Development, Irrigation, etc.). It also confers specific powers to another named individual (Swarna Jayanthi Wedaarachchi) with detailed descriptions of those powers under specific sections of the Co-operative Societies Law. This combination of named individuals and detailed responsibilities/portfolios qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
